findings.description: Handlebars provides the power necessary to let users build semantic templates. From 3.0.0 until 4.7.10, Handlebars lookupProperty returns Function.prototype.constructor before applying the prototype-access deny list because constructor is an own property of Function.prototype. When an attacker can render a controlled template with allowProtoMethodsByDefault enabled and an accessible function in the template context, the template can traverse from that function through its prototype to Function.prototype and then obtain the Function constructor through the own-property bypass. This permits attacker-controlled JavaScript to execute with the server application's privileges. This issue is fixed in version 4.7.10.

A vulnerability was found in Linksys E1700 1.0.0.4.003. This affects the function setLinksysIpv6 of the file /goform/setLinksysIpv6. The manipulation of the argument _6rd_prefix/_6rd_prefix_len results in os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

Exposure of Sensitive System Information to an Unauthorized Control Sphere vulnerability in Dotstore WooCommerce Product Attachment woo-product-attachment allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects WooCommerce Product Attachment: from n/a through 2.3.4.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in royalnavneet Delete All Comments of wordpress delete-all-comments-of-website allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Delete All Comments of wordpress: from n/a through 7.1.

The JAXB factory methods historically relied solely on `FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING` to prevent XML External Entity (XXE) resolution. On JAXP implementations where that feature alone does not block external entity resolution, an attacker who can get untrusted XML unmarshalled through JAXB can read local files via out-of-band XXE.
Path traversal in Smart Switch prior to version 3.7.73 allows physical attackers to access files with Smart Switch privilege.
Out-of-bounds write in libsamsungtts.so prior to SMR Oct-2026 Release 1 allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code.
Use after free in WSM service prior to SMR Oct-2026 Release 1 allows local attackers to potentially execute arbitrary code with system privilege.
Out-of-bounds write in libsmkvextractor.so prior to SMR Oct-2026 Release 1 allows local attackers to execute arbitrary code.

Denver SHO-110 IP cameras expose a secondary HTTP service on TCP port 8001 that provides access to a '/snapshot' endpoint without authentication. While the primary web interface on port 80 enforces authentication, the backdoor service allows any remote attacker to retrieve image snapshots by directly requesting the 'snapshot' endpoint. An attacker can repeatedly collect snapshots and reconstruct the camera stream, compromising the confidentiality of the monitored environment.

A flaw was found in environment-modules. A local attacker can exploit this vulnerability by placing a maliciously named modulefile in a location visible to the victim's `MODULEPATH`. When the victim uses Bash completion for `module` or `ml` commands, the malicious module name, containing shell metacharacters, is evaluated as a command. This can lead to arbitrary command execution in the completing user's shell, impacting their confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

A flaw was found in tftp-hpa. When the `in.tftpd` remap engine processes an inverse remap rule that also aborts with a non-empty custom error message, it can pass invalid match offsets to the `genmatchstring()` function. This leads to out-of-bounds read/write operations. A remote, unauthenticated attacker can exploit this vulnerability by sending a specially crafted request, causing the daemon to crash and resulting in a denial of service.

A weakness has been identified in Linksys E1700 1.0.0.4.003. The affected element is the function setDMZ of the file /goform/setDMZ. Executing a manipulation of the argument MAC_addr can lead to os command injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in Cozy Vision Technologies Pvt. Ltd. SMS Alert Order Notifications sms-alert allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects SMS Alert Order Notifications: from n/a through 4.0.0.

SGLang through 0.5.21 contains a denial of service vulnerability that disables Pillow decompression bomb protection process-wide by setting Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS to None in NanoNemotronVLImageProcessor. Remote attackers can submit small, highly compressed images with huge dimensions to the generic image loader, exhausting worker memory during decoding.

SGLang through 0.5.21 contains a resource budget bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to override GLM-V video processing limits by supplying fps, max_frames, max_tokens_per_frame and max_image_tokens in the video_url object. Attackers can set these values arbitrarily high so glm4v.py decodes every frame of high-resolution video at full size, exhausting worker memory and denying service.

SGLang through 0.5.21 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability in preprocess_video in qwen_vl.py that decodes frames at full source resolution before applying max_pixels limits. Remote attackers can submit high-resolution videos to /v1/chat/completions on Qwen-VL deployments, and concurrent requests exhaust worker memory causing denial of service.

SGLang through 0.5.21 contains a decompression amplification vulnerability in load_audio that allows remote attackers to exhaust memory by submitting highly compressed audio decoded without duration or sample limits. Attackers can supply small FLAC-encoded silence files through audio_url or audio_data inputs that expand into massive PCM buffers, exhausting worker memory and CPU for denial of service.

SGLang through 0.5.21 contains an unbounded memory allocation vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to exhaust memory by uploading oversized files to /v1/audio/transcriptions. Attackers can send concurrent large multipart uploads, which are fully read into memory before validation, to crash the HTTP/tokenizer worker and deny service.

Deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in Ministry of Justice General Directorate of Information Technology UYAP Document Editor allows Object Injection.

This issue affects UYAP Document Editor: before 5.4.20.

Performing a manipulation of the argument staticRoute_IP_setting/staticRoute_Netmask_setting/staticRoute_Gateway_setting/staticRoute_Metric_setting results in os command injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a username enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to identify valid accounts because the AvatarServlet (/avatar) performs no session validation. Attackers can supply usernames or numeric IDs in the userId parameter and compare 1x1 transparent images against real avatars to enumerate users and retrieve profile pictures.

LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains an unauthenticated file upload vulnerability in the UploadServlet that allows remote attackers to write files to disk without a session. Attackers can repeatedly send multipart requests with unlimited file parts to /upload, persisting files in uncleaned temporary directories and exhausting server disk space.

LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the PswRecovery servlet that fails to bind password recovery tickets to the requesting user. Attackers can obtain a ticket for their own account and reuse it with any userId, including administrators, to reset victims' passwords, lock them out, and reveal their email addresses.

LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the ConvertPdf servlet that allows authenticated users to download restricted PDF documents. Attackers can enumerate sequential docId values and use the version parameter to retrieve any PDF and its versions from folders they cannot access.

LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the zip-export servlet that allows authenticated users to export restricted folders by supplying a folderId parameter. Attackers can request /zip-export with a restricted folder ID, since ZipExport.addFolderDocuments() skips READ and DOWNLOAD permission checks, to download all of its documents in a ZIP archive.

LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in SoapDocumentService operations that allows authenticated users to access and modify unauthorized documents. Attackers can call copy, getExtractedText, deleteVersion, reindex, deleteLink, or restore via SOAP or /services/rest/document with sequential document IDs to disclose, delete, or tamper with documents.

LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the default-enabled XMLConverter that fetches xml-stylesheet href URLs without scheme or host allowlisting. Authenticated users can upload XML documents whose stylesheet href points to internal http, ftp, file, or jar URLs, forcing server requests and applying attacker-controlled XSLT during conversion.

LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute OS commands by submitting Velocity templates in DocumentService.sendAsEmail subject or message fields. Attackers can invoke SystemTool exec methods or ClassTool, bypassing the forbidRuntimeUsage denylist, to run commands with LogicalDOC process privileges.

LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains an HQL injection vulnerability in DocumentsDataServlet that allows authenticated users to manipulate queries via the unvalidated indexed parameter. Attackers with read access to any folder can inject boolean HQL expressions to bypass folder scope and read-permission checks, listing restricted document metadata and extracting database contents.

LogicalDOC Community Edition through 9.3 contains a sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to execute crafted SQL via the firstLetter parameter of TagsDataServlet. Low-privileged attackers can inject UNION SELECT statements returned in the XML tag list to read usernames, email addresses and password hashes from ld_user.

SmarterMail before build 9777 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability where JWT access and refresh tokens embed a role claim at issuance that is not revalidated against the account's current role when redeemed through POST /api/v1/auth/refresh-token. Attackers who capture a refresh token issued before an administrator demotion, or a demoted user whose session was not actively polling at the time of demotion, can replay the stale token to obtain a new access token retaining the higher-privilege role (such as DomainAdmin or SysAdmin) until natural token expiry.

SmarterMail before build 9777 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows an attacker holding a SysAdmin-scoped access token to bypass the Volume Mount script-directory containment control by provisioning a new mail domain with an arbitrary FileStore root path inside the trusted Scripts directory via the domain-put endpoint. Attackers can disclose the Scripts path through the AddOrUpdateMount endpoint, clear the upload extension blacklist via the global-mail endpoint, then upload a malicious script through the ordinary mail file-storage upload API so that saving a CommandMount triggers RunScript before validation, resulting in a reverse shell executing as the SmarterMail service account with SYSTEM-level privileges.

A vulnerability was determined in Linksys E1700 1.0.0.4.003. This vulnerability affects the function ssid1MACFilter of the file /goform/ssid1MACFilter of the component Mac Filter. This manipulation of the argument newap_text_%d causes stack-based buffer overflow. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

LavaLite CMS through 10.1.2 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated low-privileged users to modify other users' accounts by abusing the AbstractRequest isWorkflow() check. Attackers can send a PATCH request to the user update route with a target identifier to change name, email, password, status, or mobile, including for administrators.

A vulnerability has been found in yangzongzhuan RuoYi up to 4.8.3. This affects the function checkRoleAllowed of the file /system/role/authDataScope. Such manipulation of the argument roleKey leads to improper privilege management. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

Improper Certificate Validation vulnerability in hexpm hex_core allows an attacker who can intercept HTTPS connections to impersonate hex.pm, repo.hex.pm or any other repository or API server to programs that use hex_core's default HTTP adapter on Erlang/OTP 24, or on OTP 25 when the operating system's CA certificates can't be loaded.

hex_core:default_config/0 selects the built-in hex_http_httpc adapter. For an HTTPS request whose adapter config has no ssl option, hex_http_httpc:http_options/2 builds options that verify the server certificate against public_key:cacerts_get/0. When that call raises, the adapter prints a warning and sends the request without ssl options, so httpc uses the defaults of the ssl application, which before OTP 26 don't verify the server certificate. public_key:cacerts_get/0 doesn't exist on OTP 24, so every HTTPS request falls back there, and on OTP 25 it raises when no CA store is found. hex_core versions before 0.11.0 never set ssl options, so they don't verify the server certificate on OTP 25 and earlier whether or not a CA store is found.

The fallback was intended and documented, but the documentation didn't make clear that it meant no certificate verification. Since hex_core 0.8.2 the README has warned that the built-in httpc adapter "has insecure default settings" and recommended other HTTP clients, and the adapter prints "using default ssl options which are insecure" on every request that falls back. hex_core 0.11.0 added certificate verification with the changelog entry "Use secure SSL defaults for OTP 25+". Neither the README nor the warning says that the server certificate isn't verified, the README doesn't say which OTP versions the warning applies to, and on OTP 25 without CA certificates the warning tells users to upgrade to OTP 25 or later, which they already run. This advisory is published so that users who took those notices as general advice know their HTTPS requests weren't authenticated.

This issue affects hex_core: from 0.1.0 before 0.20.0.

A vulnerability has been found in BlackBeltTechnology pi-agent-dashboard up to 0.8.0. Affected by this issue is the function terminalManager.spawn of the file packages/server/src/browser-handlers/terminal-handler.ts of the component Terminal Handler. The manipulation of the argument cwd leads to improper authorization. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The identifier of the patch is 48fd0bad5adfe76af9736599699d51a5f60019f6. It is suggested to install a patch to address this issue. The vendor was contacted early, responded in a very professional manner and quickly released a fixed version of the affected product.

jshERP through 3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privilege authenticated users to create tenant-wide master data via add and import endpoints lacking role checks. Attackers can send POST requests to endpoints like /account/add, /material/add, or /material/importExcel to create settlement accounts, products with initial stock, departments and dictionary entries.

jshERP through 3.6 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to read platform-wide configuration secrets via the getInfoByKey handler of PlatformConfigController. Low-privilege users of any tenant can request arbitrary platformKey values such as email_auth_code or activation_code to obtain SMTP authorization codes and activation secrets, because only aliOss and weixin keys are blocked.

jshERP through 3.6 contains a mass assignment vulnerability in the UserController update handler that allows authenticated users to overwrite protected fields including tenant_id and password. Attackers can send a crafted PUT /user/update body to switch into another tenant on next login or overwrite other users' password hashes for account takeover.

jshERP through 3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the UserController updateUser handler that allows authenticated users to assign arbitrary roles to any user. Low-privilege attackers can send their own user id with the tenant administrator roleId to escalate privileges or rebind other tenant users' roles.

jshERP through 3.6 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows low-privilege authenticated users to read any settlement account ledger by supplying an arbitrary accountId. Attackers restricted to personal or department data scope can query GET /account/findAccountInOutList to view other users' bill numbers, counterparties, amounts and remarks within the tenant.

jshERP through 3.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to create pre-approved bills by setting status in POST /depotHead/addDepotHeadAndDetail requests. Attackers can supply a status of 1 to skip audit permission checks and multi-level approval workflows, creating audited bills that affect stock and report queries.

jshERP through 3.6 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in GET /supplier/exportExcel that allows authenticated users to bypass role data scope restrictions enforced by /supplier/list. Attackers restricted to personal or department data can export every supplier, customer and member record, exposing contacts, phone numbers, tax numbers, bank accounts and balances.

jshERP through 3.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users restricted to personal or department data to list other users' bills by adding a purchaseStatus value. Attackers can include purchaseStatus=0 in the search JSON on GET /depotHead/list, causing DepotHeadService.select to drop the creator filter and expose all tenant purchase, sales and inventory bills.

jshERP through 3.6 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read data from unassigned warehouses by supplying depotId or depotIds request parameters. When depot_flag warehouse restriction is enabled, attackers can name arbitrary warehouse ids in endpoints like /depotItem/getMaterialDepotStockByParam to read stock levels, batch numbers, sales figures and priced bill lines within the tenant.

jshERP through 3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in LogController that allows any authenticated user to read the tenant's operation audit log. Low-privilege users can send GET requests to /log/list or /log/info to view other users' login names, client IP addresses, and actions.

jshERP through 3.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in LogController that allows any authenticated user to forge, modify, or delete audit log entries. Low-privilege users can call /log/add, /log/update, /log/delete, and /log/deleteBatch to fabricate entries, rewrite user and IP fields, or erase records to hide activity.

MoguBlog through 6.2 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to move or rename other administrators' network-disk files by supplying their file paths. Attackers can send crafted requests to POST /networkDisk/moveFile, batchMoveFile, or edit, which update rows without admin_uid checks, relocating or renaming other users' files and folders.

MoguBlog through 6.2 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to delete other administrators' files via POST /networkDisk/deleteFile and batchDeleteFile. Attackers can supply another administrator's file or folder uid, which NetworkDiskServiceImpl.deleteFile never checks against admin_uid, removing stored objects from local storage, Qiniu or MinIO.

MoguBlog through 6.2 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to list other administrators' network-disk files via POST /networkDisk/getFileList. Attackers can query the endpoint, which filters only by status, file type, or filePath and never by admin_uid, to obtain other administrators' file names and download URLs.

MoguBlog through 6.2 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows low-privileged front-end users to read system credentials via the getSystemConfig endpoint. Attackers can supply an ordinary reader session token to retrieve unfiltered SystemConfig data, exposing Qiniu and MinIO secret keys and SMTP mailbox passwords.

yshop-crm through 2.1.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated back-office user to approve or reject invoices via POST /admin-api/crm/invoice/check. The CrmInvoiceController check handler lacks @PreAuthorize and approver checks are commented out, letting attackers bypass the invoice approval workflow by supplying any invoice id.

yshop-crm through 2.1.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated back-office user to approve or reject receivables records by calling POST /admin-api/crm/contract-receivables/check. The handler lacks a @PreAuthorize check and the approver checks in CrmContractReceivablesServiceImpl.check are commented out, so attackers can approve records by id, inflating contract return_money and forging approval logs.

yshop-crm through 2.1.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated back-office user to approve or reject contracts by calling POST /admin-api/crm/contract/check. Because CrmContractController lacks @PreAuthorize and approver checks are commented out, attackers can approve contracts to alter customer deal and purchase data or reject them to return products to stock.

lamp-cloud through 5.10.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to list other business objects' file attachments by supplying an arbitrary bizId to the listFileByBizId endpoint. Attackers can retrieve file names, storage paths, MD5 hashes and stored URLs, which in default LOCAL storage are served without login under /anyTenant/file.

TDuck survey form through 6.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the saveFormTheme handler that allows authenticated users to overwrite other users' form themes. Attackers whose form has no theme can submit another form's sequential theme id with their own formKey, replacing its colours and image URLs and removing the victim's theme.

lamp-cloud through 5.10.1 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to obtain storage URLs for other users' files by supplying arbitrary file ids. Attackers can send another user's file ids to the findUrlById handler of FileAnyoneController, which never checks ownership, to retrieve access URLs and read uploaded attachments.

TDuck survey form through 6.0 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows authenticated users to add fields to other users' forms via POST /user/form/item/batch/create. Attackers can submit an array whose first element references their own form and later elements reference a victim's formKey, injecting attacker-chosen fields onto the victim's public fill page.

TDuck survey form through 6.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to delete other users' form submissions by supplying arbitrary submission ids. Attackers can place their own formKey in the path and iterate sequential submission ids in the request body to permanently delete submissions platform-wide.

ImageMagick before 6.9.13-58 and 7.x before 7.1.2-33 does not properly account for symbolic links in the IsRightsAuthorizedByName security policy check, allowing configured policy restrictions to be bypassed. Local attackers who can create a symlink can point it at a policy-restricted path to evade the configured policy.

A flaw has been found in Yungengxin Cloud Billing 2024.11.28.11. Affected by this vulnerability is the function sub_14000443C in the library LWBilling64.sys of the component IOCTL Process Termination. Executing a manipulation of the argument Pid can lead to exposed ioctl with insufficient access control. The attack needs to be launched locally. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
An OS Command Injection vulnerability affecting Tuleap Enterprise Edition from 17.0 through 17.5 could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the server.

In Progress ShareFile Storage Zones Controller v5.12.6 and below, FileCopyService uses a remote file identifier when constructing a local temporary file path without enforcing containment. This can cause FileCopyService to write attacker-controlled content to filesystem locations writable by the service account. This can result in remote code execution when an executable IIS-served directory is writable.

In Progress ShareFile Storage Zones Controller v5.12.6 and below, processing of queue items can send acknowledgements to an unvalidated callback URL, this behavior together with a race condition allows the attacker to cause FileCopyService to consume attacker-controlled metadata and content. Exploitation requires control over copy queue work and a race condition.

In Progress ShareFile Storage Zones Controller v5.12.6 and below, improper validation of outbound request destinations and parameters, unsafe JSONP response formatting, and insufficient validation on queue service can be chained by a remote unauthenticated attacker to issue server-side requests to unintended local handlers and perform unauthorized queue operations.

A vulnerability has been found in Ollama up to 0.34.1. The affected element is the function IsValid of the file types/model/name.go of the component Pull API. The manipulation leads to server-side request forgery. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. Upgrading to version 0.34.2 is sufficient to fix this issue. The identifier of the patch is dfabde4539e42ba1e1eab50a3a50b88aea7958a0. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component.

An incorrect authorization vulnerability in the WinBox
authentication flow of MikroTik RouterOS allows a remote authenticated attacker
with credentials for a low-privilege account permitted to use WinBox to obtain
the authorization policy of a different existing account. The stage-one EC-SRP
challenge and proof are verified using the attacker's account, while the
independently supplied stage-two username is used to install the target
account's privileges. By specifying a higher-privilege account such as admin, a
low-privilege user can obtain a full administrative session without knowing the
target account's password and can use that session to increase the privileges
of the attacker's own account.
A Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability affecting Tuleap Enterprise Edition from 17.0 through 17.5 could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary script code in user's browser session.
A Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability affecting Tuleap Enterprise Edition from 17.0 through 17.5 could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary script code in user's browser session.
A Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability affecting Tuleap Enterprise Edition from 17.0 through 17.5 could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary script code in user's browser session.

An Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key vulnerability affecting Tuleap Enterprise Edition from 17.0 through 17.5 could allow an attacker with tracker administration rights on one tracker to update or delete fields of all the trackers on the instance.
An SQL Injection vulnerability affecting Tuleap Enterprise Edition 17.5 could allow an attacker to have read access the Tuleap database.

A vulnerability was determined in Zen Cart up to 2.2.2. Affected is the function zen_call_function of the file admin/includes/functions/general.php of the component Administrative Module Management. Executing a manipulation of the argument use_function can lead to code injection. The attack can be launched remotely. Attacks of this nature are highly complex. The exploitability is told to be difficult. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor explains: "We don't consider this an independently exploitable vulnerability. The only path to controlling `use_function`/`configuration_value` in the `configuration` table is the SQL Patch tool (raw arbitrary SQL execution) or a pre-existing SQL injection elsewhere".

A vulnerability was identified in Zen Cart 2.2.2. Affected by this vulnerability is the function eval of the file admin/configuration.php of the component Admin Panel. The manipulation of the argument gID leads to sql injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. The attack is considered to have high complexity. The exploitation appears to be difficult. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor explains: "`set_function`/`use_function` are not editable through any normal admin UI (only at plugin-install time via SQL, or via direct database access)".

A flaw has been found in Yungengxin Yun Jia Security Guard up to 2.7.1.9. Impacted is the function sub_14000885C in the library kgameprotect.sys. Executing a manipulation of the argument Pid can lead to improper privilege management. The attack requires local access. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in imithemes NativeChurch nativechurch allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects NativeChurch: from n/a before 4.9.5.

Improper Authorization vulnerability in Apache SkyWalking BanyanDB.



The Canopy includes incomplete proof-of-concept role and monitoring-proxy functionality. Under a non-default configuration with a readonly Canopy user and a reachable monitoring target, that user can send non-read requests through the monitoring proxy.



This issue affects Apache SkyWalking BanyanDB: from 0.11.0 before 0.11.1.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 0.11.1, which fixes the issue.

The Hotel Booking WordPress plugin through 3.8 does not verify that a booking record belongs to the user requesting it, allowing any authenticated user such as a Subscriber to read other customers' booking details, including their name, email address, phone number and postal address, by referencing an identifier they do not own.

The Hotel Booking WordPress plugin through 3.8 does not implement CSRF protection on its administrative booking order management, allowing attackers to trick a logged-in administrator into creating, deleting, or modifying arbitrary booking order records via a forged request.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in DLX Plugins Custom Query Blocks post-type-archive-mapping allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Custom Query Blocks: from n/a through 5.6.0.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in WP Desk Flexible Subscriptions flexible-subscriptions allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Flexible Subscriptions: from n/a through 1.8.4.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Codection Products Restricted Users for WooCommerce woo-products-restricted-users allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Products Restricted Users for WooCommerce: from n/a through 0.7.

The WP Comment Cleaner  WordPress plugin before 7.2 does not perform a capability check or validate a nonce on one of its bulk comment-deletion routines, allowing authenticated users with minimal permissions, such as subscribers, to permanently delete all comments on the site.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in NOUS Ouvert Utile et Simple Event post event-post allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Event post: from n/a through 6.1.1.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in VideoWhisper.com VideoWhisper Site Manager for ChatGPT, Claude, Codex videowhisper-site-manager allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects VideoWhisper Site Manager for ChatGPT, Claude, Codex: from n/a through 1.2.10.

Improper Validation of Specified Quantity in Input vulnerability in VideoWhisper.com Paid Videochat Turnkey Site ppv-live-webcams allows Input Data Manipulation.This issue affects Paid Videochat Turnkey Site: from n/a through 7.5.12.

Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key vulnerability in NOUS Ouvert Utile et Simple Event post event-post allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Event post: from n/a through 6.1.1.

Improper Validation of Specified Quantity in Input vulnerability in WP Desk Flexible Quantity – Measurement Price Calculator for WooCommerce flexible-quantity-measurement-price-calculator-for-woocommerce allows Input Data Manipulation.This issue affects Flexible Quantity – Measurement Price Calculator for WooCommerce: from n/a through 2.3.22.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in VillaTheme TMDS tmds-dropshipping-for-temu-and-woo allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects TMDS: from n/a through 1.0.15.

The HireZoot  WordPress plugin before 4.0.0 does not sanitise and escape one of its job specification settings before it is reflected back into an admin-area settings page, allowing users with the HireZoot  WordPress plugin before 4.0.0's management capability (Administrator by default) to store a payload that is executed in the browser of any administrator who later opens that page. As the unfiltered_html capability is not available to administrators on multisite (or where DISALLOW_UNFILTERED_HTML is set), this leads to Stored Cross-Site Scripting.

Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data vulnerability in Pluggabl LLC. Booster Elite for WooCommerce booster-elite-for-woocommerce allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects Booster Elite for WooCommerce: from n/a before 8.4.0.

A deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability was found in ManageIQ. The YamlLoadAliases module overrides YAML.safe_load to silently fall back to YAML.unsafe_load in production when a Psych::DisallowedClass error occurs. An authenticated attacker with dialog import access can exploit this to achieve remote code execution by uploading a crafted YAML payload that triggers the fallback and deserializes arbitrary Ruby objects.

Red Hat CloudForms, which was based on ManageIQ, has reached End of Life and is no longer supported. No errata or patches will be issued. This CVE is being assigned for the benefit of the ManageIQ community and downstream consumers.

A vulnerability was detected in Cairo-dock Glx-Dock up to 3.4.0. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file ww_page.php of the component Query Parameter Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument p results in cross site scripting. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

DJI drones transmit DUML (DJI Universal Markup Language) protocol messages over BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy) without encryption. When a client attempts to connect to the drone over Wi-Fi, or when the drone is switched to QuickTransfer mode, the DJI Fly application exchanges DUML messages with the drone over BLE, including the Wi-Fi credentials. An attacker within BLE range can passively sniff this traffic and recover the credentials in cleartext, including the drone's Wi-Fi PSK, SSID, and trusted identifier UUID. Obtaining these credentials allows the attacker to join the drone's internal Wi-Fi network, interact with network services exposed by the drone, and decrypt Wi-Fi traffic exchanged between the drone and the legitimate user.

* An attacker within BLE range recovers the Wi-Fi SSID and PSK in cleartext, and can then join the drone's network 
* The same capture also exposes the session UUID identifier, which is the only thing the drone uses to tell a trusted client from an unknown one, so the attacker can replay it and skip the physical confirmation of new connected devices.
* The credentials do not change between sessions unless the operator manually resets the Wi-Fi settings, so one capture stays valid indefinitely
* The attack is fully passive, with nothing transmitted and no connection made, so neither the operator nor the drone has any indication the session was observed
* A BLE sniffer and presence during one normal DJI Fly connection are needed

Affected models are DJI Neo until 01.00.0400, DJI Neo 2 until 01.00.0500, DJI Flip until 01.00.1200, DJI Air 3 until 01.00.1600, DJI Air 3S until 01.00.1400, DJI Avata 2 until 01.00.0400, DJI Avata 360 until 01.00.0300, DJI Mavic 3 until 01.00.1400, DJI Mavic 3 Classic until 01.00.0800, DJI Mavic 3 Pro until 01.01.0700, DJI Mavic 4 Pro until 01.00.0500, DJI Mini 2 until 01.07.0200, DJI Mini 3 until 01.00.0500, DJI Mini 3 Pro until 01.00.0900, DJI Mini 4 Pro until 01.00.1100, and DJI Mini 5 Pro until 01.00.0600.

Remediation requires a firmware update from the vendor. There is no user-side mitigation that fully addresses the vulnerability without upgrading.
